Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 28-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Satellite Communication [ECE_3126]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Provide the comparison between low earth orbit, medium earth orbit and geosynchronous Earth                (4)  
  orbit satellites.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Establish the need for Satellite Communication.                                                            (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Describe the following terms with respect to Satellite Communication                                       (3)  
  a. Subsatellite path  
  b. Perigee  
  c. Prograde orbit  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                With neat diagrams, explain the commonly employed techniques for satellite attitude control                (5)  
  (stabilization techniques). Tabulate the differences between them.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           i) The apogee and perigee distances of a satellite orbiting in an elliptical orbit are respectively    (5)  
  45000 km and 7000 km. Calculate the following:  
  a. Semi-major axis of the elliptical orbit  
  b. Orbit eccentricity. Comment about the shape of the satellite orbit and whether the satellite can be  
  a GEO satellite.  
  
  ii) A satellite is orbiting the Earth at an altitude of 600 km above the Earth's surface. Given that the  
  radius of the Earth is 6371 km, calculate the maximum line-of-sight distance between the satellite  
  and a point on the Earth's surface (i.e., the distance from the satellite to the horizon). Assume the  
  elevation angle is 0° (the horizon case).  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Establish the need for batteries on board the satellite. Provide a detailed note on the different type     (4)  
  of batteries used.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           With a neat block diagram, explain the satellite tracking system                                           (4)  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)               List all the subsystems of a typical satellite                                                             (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4)                       Provide a detailed note on the following related to the satellite communication link                       (5)  
  (I). Free-space loss  
  A)               (II). Gaseous absorption  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)               (I). Discuss in detail the CDMA technique used in satellite communication                                  (5)  
  (II). List the advantages of TDMA over FDMA  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                       Outline and summarize any five applications of weather forecasting satellites in detail                    (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                                Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)               With neat diagrams, explain                                                                                (5)  
  (I). Satellite-cable television  
  (II). Direct-to-Home satellite television  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
